Bloc:1775 Lots : 3b6 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTDECLARATION 七u DECLARATIONmadeasofthis( dayof November,2018(this "Declaration"), by 1775 TP4 HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., a New Corp., 242 W. 36"h Street, New York, NY 10018 (the “1775 Fee Owner"), 1775 HOUSES TP4 LLC, a New York State limited liability company with an address c/o Tahl Propp Equities LLC, 405 Park Avenue, Suite 1103, New York, New York 10022 (the “1775 Beneficial Owner” and together with the 1775 Fee Owner, the "1775 0wner"), RECITALS: 1775 Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 107 East 126th Street, New York, New York, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A (Legal Description), annexed hereto (the “Property"). The Property is identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York ("Tax Map") as Block 1775, Lots 3 and 6 (Block 1775, Lot 3, hereinafter referred to as “Lot 3"; Block 1775, Lot 6, hereinafter referred to as “Lot 6"). Lot 3 and Lot 6 are each subject to a tax lot reapportionment application that is pending before the NYC Department of Finance and will result in each tax lot, Lot 3 and Lot 6 taking on the separate metes and bounds described in Exhibit A (Legal Description). The Property is owned by the 1775 Owner (1775 Owner, as owner of Lot 3, hereinafter referred to as “Developer"; 1775 Owner, as owner of Lot 6, hereinafter referred to as “Owner"; Lot 3 with buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as"Developer's Building"; Lot 6 with buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as "Owner's Building"; and Lot 6 and Owner's Building, collectively, "Owner's Parcel"). Owner's Building was developed pursuant to the Harlem-East Harlem Urban Renewal Plan (CP20528, November 20, 1968, as amended, the “URP") and the East Harlem Triangle Large-Scale Residential Development Plan (the “LSRD" and together with the URP, the “Historic Zoning Restrictions").The Historic Zoning Restrictions restrict future development of the Property, but allow the Owner's Building to exceed the residential development capacity under the zoning designations currently applicable to the Property. To facilitate new development on the Property, the Developer intends to apply for certain Developer's Approvals to Upzone (as such terms are hereinafter defined) the zoning designations applicable to the Property and terminate the Historic Zoning Restrictions. Lot 3 and Lot 6 are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance in excessof10linearfeet Developer may desire in the future to enlarge Developer's Building or demolish Developer's Building and construct a new building or buildings on a development site comprising all or a portion of Lot 3 and/or any Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) and to 8369296.2

Block1775,Lots 3 and 6 construct other improvements associated with such new building or buildings (said enlargement or new building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as the “New Building"; Developer's Building, the New Building and any and all building and improvements now or hereafter located on Lot 3 and/or any Additional Parcels, hereinafter referred to collectively as“Developer's Parcel")which New Building will contain more Development Rights than would be permitted on Lot 3 if considered as a single zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). To effectuate the transfer of Development Rights from Lot 6 to Lot 3 and to enable Developer to construct the New Building, 1775 Beneficial Owner has identified Lot 3 and Lot 6 as a single zoning lot, as stated in the Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement, dated May 11, 2018 and recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, New York County at CRFN 2018000162420 (the "Combined Zoning Lot"). To achieve these objectives, 1775 Owner wishes to declare for the purpose of establishing and setting forth the rights and obligations of the Parties (hereafter defined) to this Declaration with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, as the same may be further enlarged or subdivided pursuant to the terms of this Declaration, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or action from the other. NOW, THEREFORE, 1775 Owner declares that the Owner's Parcel and the Developer's Parcel are hereby restricted and subject to the following: ARTICLE I DEFINITIONS;DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS Section 1.1 As used in this Declaration: (a) hereafter acquired by Developer which are appurtenant to Additional Parcels. (b) "Additional Parcels" shall mean any other property within Block 1775 that is contiguous to any portion of the Combined Zoning Lot for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet (or contiguous for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet within any other lot hereafter made part of the Combined Zoning Lot). All references to Additional Parcels shall be deemed to refer to any one Additional Parcel or any combination of such Additional Parcels that Developer elects to include in the Combined Zoning Lot. (c) "Building" shall mean Developer's Building or Owner's Building, as applicable.
